news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.021 (vs ₹0.03 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.021 (down from ₹0.03 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹8.88m (up 6.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹232.2k (down 19% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.6% (down from 3.4% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 12% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 29% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Financial data availability
news.body: The company's latest financial reports are more than 6 months old. Last reported fiscal period ended September 2025. This is considered a minor risk. If the company has not reported its earnings on time, it may have been delayed due to audit problems or it may be finding it difficult to reconcile its accounts. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Shares are highly illiquid. Revenue is less than US$1m (₹7.5m revenue, or US$79k). Market cap is less than US$10m (₹125.8m market cap, or US$1.33m). Minor Risk Latest financial reports are more than 6 months old (reported September 2025 fiscal period end).

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 3 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Non-Executive Independent Director Amruta Giradkar was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2020. The company’s insufficient board refreshment is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
